title: Sage Green Taffeta Silk Gota Work Anarkali Suit Set with Sequin Organza Dupatta
description:
An elegant sage green Anarkali suit set in lustrous taffeta silk, finished with shimmering gota lace – handcrafted in Jaipur by Bahe Kurtiz.

The Anarkali has a flattering V-neckline, full sleeves, a fitted bodice and a dramatic, full-flare skirt that twirls beautifully with every step. The hem is detailed with rows of gota lace and a delicate gota edge for a festive Rajasthani finish. It comes with matching pants and a sheer organza dupatta embroidered with sparkling sequins and edged with gota lace.

• Anarkali: taffeta silk, V-neck, full sleeves, full flare, gota lace hem, ankle length
• Pant: matching sage green, comfortable straight fit
• Dupatta: organza with sequin embroidery and gota lace border
• Rich sheen that glows in evening light and photos
• Perfect for mehendi, sangeet, wedding guest looks, Diwali, Karwa Chauth and Eid

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth, away from moisture, to keep the gota and sequins bright. Steam or iron on low heat on the reverse side.
